title: Visage

inlines.v: VIS'AGE, noun s as z. [Latin visus, video.] The face; the countenance or look of a person, or of other animal; chiefly applied to human beings; as a wolfish visage Love and beauty still that visage grace. His visage was so marred, more than any man. Isaiah 52:14.
